Definition: Chebron, a place in Palestine, also the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hebron = "association"; n pr loc; 1) a city in south Judah approx 20 south of Jerusalem and approx 20 miles (30 km) north of Beersheba and near where Abraham built an altar; n pr m; 2) the 3rd son of Kohath and grandson of Levi; 3) a descendant of Caleb
